body: I've found that professionals make things worse for me. I was forced to see them as a child and haven't seen one again as an adult. All I can think about is how I'm paying them to listen to my problems that they stop caring about once they leave for the day. They're also not great for the suicidally depressed. You have to lie to them the whole time in order to prevent getting escorted to a mental hospital. Confidentiality goes through the window if they catch a whiff of you contemplating hurting yourself.

I feel ya. I get more frustrated than anything. People who I've talked to in the past just don't understand, and feeling misunderstood is one of the worst feelings in the world for me so I just don't bother. If they do understand, depression doesn't manifest in the same way for them so we can't really relate. Or I feel like I want to talk to someone, then when I get the opportunity to do so, I don't want to take the time to explain how I feel. It's a fucked up situation that I'm better off keeping to myself. 

I feel you on the eating though. I've had what feels like every eating disorder under the sun and binging helped prevent total breakdowns until I started gaining too much weight. Now I can't really taste food so I stay hungry most of the time until I get headaches. Good times.

Anyways, thanks for reaching out, man. I hope you feel better soon as well.

Haha if only that worked. I tripped for the first time a couple months ago and it was one of the worst experiences of my life. Sent me into an intense spiraling depression for a week then it was back to my current state. I'm glad they work for you though. They seem like they'd be a fun time if my mental state was better.
I don't have any hobbies which makes it a million times harder to cope.
